task_decomposition: Model 1 extracts the frozen evidence into a structured evidence table, including run counts, stages, variants, profiles, pass/fail results, allowed claims, and forbidden claims.
Model 2 independently classifies C1-C6 as supported, unsupported, or forbidden using only the structured evidence and flags any ambiguity.

Model 3 reviews Model 2's classifications against the explicit allowed and forbidden claim lists, with special attention to overclaims about production deployment, packet-capture benchmarking, public-chain benchmarking, media-plane QoE, and six-variant ablation.
Model 4 acts as verifier/arbiter, compares all prior outputs to the frozen evidence, resolves disagreements conservatively, and emits final claim-boundary decisions with brief evidence references.
success_criteria: All six claims C1-C6 are classified using only the frozen evidence.

Supported claims are limited to local workflow repeatability, local evidence-grounded model/tool orchestration, executable baseline comparison, profile-labelled orchestration robustness, and inter-model claim-boundary checking around the local artifact.

Forbidden claims are rejected, including production O-RAN deployment validation, packet-capture network-impairment benchmark, public-chain benchmark, full media-plane QoE validation, and 240-run six-variant ablation.
The verifier/arbiter identifies C1, C2, and C5 as evidence-consistent, and C3, C4, and C6 as forbidden or unsupported.
No model asserts production readiness, packet-capture benchmarking, public-chain performance, full media-plane QoE validation, or a 240-run six-variant ablation.
parsed.candidate_safe_claim: The artifact supports local evidence-grounded orchestration and claim-boundary checking, including 156 executed local n8n evidence runs before the Stage E/F model-assisted extension and 120 passed Stage D-real executions across three implemented variants.
candidate_risky_claims_to_check: The evidence proves production O-RAN deployment readiness.
The artifact includes a 240-run six-variant ablation study.
The results are a packet-capture network-impairment benchmark.
The evidence demonstrates public-chain benchmark performance.
The evidence validates full media-plane QoE.
parsed.next_agent_instruction: Act as the evidence extraction agent. Convert the frozen evidence into a concise structured table of stages, run counts, variants, profiles, outcomes, allowed claim types, and forbidden claim types. Do not infer beyond the provided evidence.
